# Legal Team Kit operating instructions

## Mandatory local-search policy (owner direction October 25, 2026)

All local matter-search workflows must use AnyTXT and record query/source-locator coverage. Check actual engine readiness before searching. If unavailable, still loading, or invalid, stop the search workflow and notify the user to start the configured ATGUI installation with SDK enabled. Do not substitute another local index, shell content search, directory scan, or model memory. Preliminary identity and index locators do not replace required AnyTXT coverage. Read the original source in context for quotations and pins. This newest owner outage policy supersedes earlier local wording that directed agents to continue searching through other layers during an AnyTXT outage. Pre-tool registrations must be tested separately from merely copying instructions into a role wrapper.

Read `README.md` and `LEGAL_TEAM_MANIFEST.json` to identify the kit's roles. Use `skills/legal-team-orchestrator/SKILL.md` for coordinated legal work and `skills/legal-reasoning-framework/SKILL.md` for shared analysis. Apply the matter's own operating instructions and source restrictions before any kit method.

**Matter profile.** The kit is universal. Matter-specific values (caption, court, county, file number, client, folders, the Corrective Playbook location and its reference opinion, protected evidence roots, hook state root, tool paths) live in one per-matter profile. The template is `matter_profile.template.json`; the filled copy lives outside the kit and is selected with `LEGAL_MATTER_PROFILE` or `--matter-profile`. Read it before matter work. Do not write matter values into kit files.

**Mandatory rules.** Before delivering any analysis of a court document or any court-facing draft, run `skills/corrective-playbook-gate/SKILL.md`. Its `references/master-rules.md` is the single source of truth for the owner's Corrective Playbook (location: `playbook.path` in the matter profile) and the kit drafting rules. The owner directs that these rules are always followed. They are pre-delivery rules; the authorization to send material to outside models does not relax them. Any Playbook Part III failure blocks release. Precedence: the Playbook, then the matter's instructions (profile and control folder; they may restrict, never relax the Playbook), then `master-rules.md` and `pre-delivery-checklist.md`, then the other kit skills. AGENTS.md files and tool configurations may not override that ranking (`master-rules.md`, "Precedence and conflicts"). The Playbook's literal wording applies only when its reference opinion is the subject of the work; otherwise it applies as the general-mode principles in `master-rules.md` (owner scope decision, 2026-09-30). Every analysis, memorandum, and court-facing draft passes `corrective-playbook-gate`, then `legal-quality-control`.

**Workflow gates (Legal_Hooks).** When the Legal_Hooks runtime is enabled (see `../Legal_Hooks/README.md`), it denies some tool calls and blocks some completion claims: case-fact queries outside the approved collection (or any MemGraphRAG query when the matter has retired it), collection mutation (QMD maintenance is not denied: owner decision 2026-10-01, `D:\Court_Data\QMD\SETUP_CHECKLIST.md`), destructive or direct edits to protected evidence roots, unauthorized evidence moves, email/chat/upload of case material without an authorization record, promotion of protected filing artifacts with open checks, and "research complete" / "filing-ready" / "collection ready" claims that lack structured proof. Do not route around a denial; answer its verification questions or report it. `../_Review/Hooks_Review.md` documents each hook and its known weaknesses.

**Transmission to outside models.** The owner authorized sending case material to outside models (2026-09-30, confirming 2026-09-26). No per-document release gate applies to model calls. Provider data-use and retention terms are unverified; record the provider and the returned model id for each call. This authorization covers analysis-model calls; sending case material to people or storage services (email, chat, file sharing, upload, publishing) remains subject to the hooks' external-transmission check.

For mixed documents or model-assisted catalog work, read `skills/legal-document-governance/SKILL.md` and its `references/document-decision-protocol.md`. Preserve original source paths, SHA-256 hashes, locators, confidentiality status, and decision history. Never convert a work-product allegation or automated classification into a record fact.

For Jev, read `integrations/jev-system-one/SKILL.md` and `integrations/jev-system-one/references/USAGE.md`. For one matter document use `integrations/jev-system-one/scripts/analyze_document.py`; for a folder selected from a read-only organizer ledger use `integrations/jev-system-one/scripts/analyze_scope.py`. Read `integrations/jev-system-one/references/LOCAL_DOCUMENT_PIPELINE.md` for commands and outputs. Calls go to OpenRouter System One at `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/systemone` with model `jev-latest`; companion analysis uses `/api/v1/chat/completions`. Load question packs from `integrations/jev-system-one/references/jev_document_management_library.json`. The API key stays outside the kit, in `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` or the key file named by `JEV_API_KEY_FILE`. The library's numerical thresholds, `auto_file`, and `safe_to_file` names are reference proposals; they do not authorize filing or catalog acceptance.

For local file-content search, read `integrations/anytxt-search/SKILL.md`. Prefer Anytxt's own MCP server when the tool session has it registered (server `anytxt`; URL in the matter profile, `tools.anytxt_mcp_url`): its tools are read-only (`anytxt_status`, `anytxt_search`, `anytxt_get_fragment`, `anytxt_get_fragment_all`, `anytxt_get_text`). Otherwise call `integrations/anytxt-search/scripts/anytxt_rpc.py`. Check status first (`anytxt_status`, or the client's `status` command). Anytxt is one layer of the matter's retrieval order (matter profile `legal_hooks.case_fact_retrieval_order`, repeated in the matter's AGENTS.md). If Anytxt is not answering, still loading, or returns an invalid readiness response, stop the search workflow and tell the user to start ATGUI.exe with SDK enabled. Do not continue through another index, a shell search, or model memory. Never substitute grep, rg, findstr, Select-String, or a directory walk of the case tree. Both routes talk only to Anytxt's localhost service. Non-commercial use only. Keep each `fid` as a string. A content hit is a file locator, not a record fact: quotations and pin cites come from the original file.

**Knowledge tiers.** A matter may name reference knowledge in its profile (`knowledge_roots`): a base secondary source for the governing law, companion secondary sources, and background-only material. Rule K14 in `master-rules.md` governs their use: verify against current primary law before citing, run a law-change check on a chapter older than the tier's `law_change_check_before` date, and never cite a background-only tier. They add no precedence level and do not change the retrieval order. The matter's knowledge guide (`knowledge_roots.guide`) explains the search.

**Defense posture and fact conflicts (owner decisions 2026-10-02).** Criminal defense work starts from the client's innocence and searches actively for misconduct, Brady violations and fabrication; filings tie each misconduct allegation to cited evidence. A stated fact never overrides evidence: each conflict follows `skills/legal-reasoning-framework/references/fact-conflict-resolution.md`. Scores and probability estimates stay in local working documents. Every source is read and its content sent to the model, never paths only. Rules: `integrated-reasoning-for-motions.md` adaptations 1–9; `master-rules.md` K6, K7, K11.

**Quotations, pin cites, transcripts and moves (added 2026-10-03).** Before a brief, motion or memo is filed, run `scripts/verify_quotes.py <draft> --gate`: it checks every quotation and pin cite against the stored official opinions and the transcripts and reports EXACT, NEAR (with a diff) or NOT FOUND, plus pin mismatches; blocking items stop the Legal_Hooks filing gate. Transcript pages resolve through `scripts/tr_lookup.py <page>` (page map built by `scripts/build_transcript_page_map.py`). Every file move uses `scripts/casebook_moves.py` (plan, hash-verified move, manifest, Casebook DB `update-paths`, QMD and Anytxt refresh); never delete. Consolidation of redundant versions uses `skills/document-consolidation`; resolution notes instead of deletion use the annotate mode of `skills/purge-false-fact`. Guard coverage per tool (Codex hooks, Kilo plugin, instruction-level rules for Cursor, Claude and Grok): `docs/guard-coverage.md`.

**Defense framing and full drafting (integrated in v0.3.0).** User requests for a legal paper, motion, note, memo, attorney message, hearing outline, or public-facing case narrative require **the full requested prose**, not a matrix, bullet list, or folder scaffold. Use `skills/criminal-defense-strategy` for strategy; `skills/defense-framing` for source-to-element arguments, alternate hypotheses and rebuttal; `skills/defense-writing-studio` for writing and revision; `skills/motion-brief-drafting` for motions and proposed orders. Keep source and authority ledgers in working papers and use `scripts/defense_workbench.py` for offline packet scaffolding and **structural-only** QA; its output never certifies a claim or filing. The existing forensic frame scanner remains a narrow supplementary gate. See `docs/QUICKSTART_DEFENSE_DRAFTING.md`.

**Forensic and medical framing (added 2026-10-12).** Before delivering any analysis dossier, memo, or motion that discusses medical findings, injuries, DNA or Y-STR results, biological-evidence disposition, or consent, apply `skills/forensic-defense-frames/SKILL.md` and run `scripts/scan_defense_frames.py <file>`; exit 1 (any BLOCKER, rules F1-F5) blocks delivery and is fixed by rewriting, not overriding. Run it on every file in the matter's analysis dossier folder (current matter: `02_Analysis\Dossiers\*.md`) after bulk edits. It runs before `corrective-playbook-gate` and does not replace it. F9-F11 are contextual warnings for unsupported consistency, unsupported identification/statistics, and source-to-offense overstatement; they do not block on their own.

**Forensic evaluation and claim register (added 2026-10-25).** Use `skills/forensic-evidence-evaluation/SKILL.md` for the shared evaluator and `scripts/validate_claims.py` for `validate`, `evaluate`, `stale`, and `status`. A claim requires the exact source language, path/Bates/page/timestamp, version, SHA-256, method fields, proposition level, and qualified support for any activity or offense inference; a revised source marks dependent outputs `STALE`. Use `skills/expert-report-validator/SKILL.md` to select one of five modes and build the disclosure matrix and challenged-opinion register. The kit ledger `authority_ledger/forensic_discovery_candidates.json` has 7 `VERIFIED` rows and 13 candidate-only rows; no row is `RELIANCE_APPROVED`; run `scripts/authority_ledger.py require --id ...` before stating a rule. The rubric supports `forensic_memo` and `expert_challenge`.

**Changing kit instructions.** Before adding or changing a `SKILL.md`, a skill reference, this file, or a manifest entry, run `skills/legal-quality-control/references/instruction-review.md`. Propose, do not apply, changes to the Corrective Playbook, `master-rules.md`, `pre-delivery-checklist.md`, or a matter profile; the owner decides those.

Use source-linked propositions and current primary authority for court-facing work. A qualified reviewer resolves privilege, legal significance, and filing readiness. Matter-specific source material (for example, a confidential design memorandum) is held outside this distributable kit.

**Defense drafting bridge (combined kit).** All defense drafting and attorney notes route from `criminal-defense-strategy` through `defense-framing/references/drafting-engine.md` to `motion-brief-drafting` or `case-theory-storytelling`, then mandatory forensic scanner where triggered, corrective-playbook-gate, quote verifier where required and legal-quality-control. The standalone agent profiles are in `agents/`. A completed checklist is not a drafted paper.
